Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 45

“The Vedas deal with the three gunas; be free of them, Arjuna. Free of dualities, ever established in purity, indifferent to acquiring and keeping, be established in the self.”

A radical instruction — go beyond even the scriptural framework. Yoga-kshema, acquiring and keeping, is the ordinary human project, and Krishna asks Arjuna to set down the whole enterprise.
